findings.current: made by milking horses and boiling the milk with his followers
findings.defect: The English attaches “with his followers” to making the wine, implying that they helped prepare it. In the Korean, it goes with Temur drinking his fill of Central Plains liquor; the mare’s-milk wine is described as made by milking and boiling the milk.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 테무르 drinks the Central Plains liquor with his subordinates, instead of mare’s-milk wine made from boiled horse’s milk.
findings.replacement: Instead of drinking mare’s-milk wine made by milking and boiling the milk, he drank his fill of fine liquor from the distant Central Plains with his followers.

summary: The translation is broadly faithful, with one minor shift in who is associated with making the mare’s-milk wine.
